Banana hazelnut chocolate granola bars 

Adding a banana and roasting it with your granola makes the loveliest flavor! 

1 ripe banana
3/4 cup of oats
2.5 cups of chopped almonds and hazelnuts
1 cups of pumpkin seed
1/2 cup raisins or dried cranberries
2/3 cup nut butter
1/3 cup maple syrup
1/2 cup coconut oil
Salt to taste

Combine all and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes or until golden brown
Cover with chocolate and cut! That’s it!

Chocolate topping (optiona)l:
1.5 cups of chocolate
.5 cips coconut oil

These have a great shelf life if you don’t eat them all up right away :)  #momof3 #healthyrecipes #healthysnacks #hikingwithkids
